# kAIosk

Use the specifier skill for every behavior change. Do not implement before a green light.

Lint with `python tools/policy/check_all.py`. Test with `python tools/policy/check_all.py`. Run architecture checks with `python tools/policy/check_all.py`. Build with `python tools/write_build_info.py`.

Do not add a comment. Do not add documentation to explain a change. Do not cross an architecture boundary recorded in `.ai/decisions.json`.
